Three comments

Ollin

Ollin is a Jig played on a low F whistle alongside Crossing Rubicon on Brian Finnegan’s new album ‘Hunger of the Skin’. My transcription is modelled around this recording, and an earlier one from ‘the Butterfly Sessions’ on youtube (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VBUdtZp7sPs), of course it being Brian Finnegan, the parts are inflected uniquely each time round (far too randomly to transcribe comprehensively). I have also opted not to include the coda-ish ending where the tune suddenly changes feel, because I wanted to keep these settings as concise as possible.

↳ Posted by benóKoroit on March 20th, 2021.

Ollin, X:2

Here is an identical setting transposed up one tone to E minor, for ease of playing on D whistles. On the setting I added earlier, in the original key, I mistakenly labelled it as being in F major. It is in fact in the relative key of D minor. There should also be a D.S. on the last bar of the 8th line, and a Segno at the beginning of the E minor setting. Not sure what happened with that.

↳ Posted by benóKoroit on March 20th, 2021.

Ollin, X:4

B minor setting for whistle. Played on a low F on the album.

↳ Posted by Yans D on April 6th, 2021.
